title: Emotional Intelligence Test
description: Measure how well you recognize your own emotions, manage them, and empathize with people around you.

questions.eq_1: I'm very aware of the specific emotion I'm feeling right now.
questions.eq_2: When I'm extremely angry or sad, I can pinpoint exactly what's causing it.
questions.eq_3: I can notice someone's mood change just from their body language or tone of voice.
questions.eq_4: I find it easy to put myself in someone else's shoes and understand their point of view (empathy).
questions.eq_5: I can stop myself from saying hurtful, unnecessary things when I'm very emotional.
questions.eq_6: I know strategies to calm myself down when I feel panicked, anxious, or under pressure.
questions.eq_7: I always think about how my words will affect others' feelings before speaking impulsively.
questions.eq_8: People feel comfortable and safe sharing their personal problems and weaknesses with me.
questions.eq_9: I can listen to and accept constructive criticism without feeling personally attacked.
questions.eq_10: I'm good at motivating myself again right after a big failure.
questions.eq_11: I don't panic easily and can still think rationally in a crisis or unexpected situation.
questions.eq_12: I can 'read the room' (e.g. tense or relaxed) as soon as I walk in.
questions.eq_13: In a conflict, I focus more on finding middle ground (a solution) than on who's to blame.
questions.eq_14: I adapt easily to big life changes without much complaining or resisting.
questions.eq_15: I don't let one bad thing in the morning ruin my mood for the whole day.
questions.eq_16: I can express disappointment assertively (clearly and firmly) without attacking others.
questions.eq_17: I'm aware of and accept that my emotional state strongly affects my performance, focus, and thinking.
questions.eq_18: I feel happy and celebrate the success of people close to me without envy creeping in.
questions.eq_19: I have full control to hide negative emotions when a situation calls for professionalism.
questions.eq_20: I'm always willing to listen to others, even when I'm feeling quite tired myself.

results.description: You still find it hard to regulate intense emotions or read other people's feelings accurately.
You manage daily emotions and empathize fairly well, with room to stay calmer in a crisis.
You have remarkable self-awareness, strong empathy, and handle conflict very well.
